decisions.issues: v02 is clean. Nagoji lies small and face down in the foam with one bandaged arm flung out. Floating timber and black rock are behind him, under a flat grey storm sky, and nobody else is on the beach. He wears no irons, chain or collar; a frayed rope end trails from his chest, which matches 1.2. There is one blank caption box at top left, clear of the figure. v01 is rejected: he is framed large and close, not small in the foam; he lies on his side with his face to camera, not face down; and his hands have no bandages, which breaks continuity with 1.2.

Minor framing drift in both. The script asks for a tight ground-level shot of the hands, but these show a medium shot with Nagoji propped on his forearms and his face raised and alert. That partly anticipates the 1.3 face close-up. Everything else is correct: bandaged fingers dug into grit (five digits each hand, thumbs on the correct side), sand-crusted left forearm turned inner side down, rope loops across the chest under the armpits with the frayed end trailing into the surf, a red chafe ring at the ankle with no irons, and the torn ochre tunic and cream dhoti. There is one blank caption box at top right, clear of the face. v02 is preferred over the near-identical v01 because its chin is cleaner, while v01 shows heavier stubble.

Nagoji's cheek is pressed to the wet sand, one eye is half open, and wet curls lie across the other eye. He has the thick curled moustache and a gold ear stud, and a sheen of wash covers his back and shoulder. His left arm is out of frame and there is one blank caption box at top left. The head is at a steep tilt but reads correctly. v02 is preferred for its clean chin; v01 shows noticeable stubble texture along the jaw and chin, which is at the limit of what the bible allows.

v01: three pairs of bare brown feet approach at low angle across wet sand, and the anatomy is sound (left and right feet paired correctly, five toes each). The tide line has moved and low light breaks under grey cloud to show time has passed, with the sea and rocks matching 1.1. It has one caption box and three blank balloons, in reading order from left to right. Minor issues: the shins show up to the knees behind the balloons, which is slightly more than just feet. The footprints lie in front of the walkers, not behind them. All three off-panel tails point straight up to the top border; the first balloon sits over the sea, left of the speakers. v05 (backup) has three correct pairs of feet but shows them huge in the foreground, standing in shallow water with no trail of prints and no visible horizon or tide line. Rejected: v02 has only five feet with the wrong left/right pairing, and its legs are cut off along a hard line beside the balloon. v03 shows disembodied feet severed at the ankles. v04 shows only two pairs of legs, and far above the feet. v06 has four sideways feet stacked at the edge, like people lying down, not approaching.

Only candidate v01 fails on anatomy. The Young Fisherman's head (centre top) floats in the sky with no neck or shoulders: it ends in a ragged, torn-looking cut under the jaw, so it reads as a severed head. His head is also drawn upright, as if he were standing in the sky, when he should be leaning in over the supine viewer from beyond the top edge. Smaller issue: the leader's white cloth sits on the viewer's left of his head, which is his RIGHT shoulder; the script and 2.4 put it on his LEFT. The leader's face, the wary elder's face, the grey sky, the photoreal-painted style and the single blank caption box in the centre sky are all fine.
decisions.correction: Anatomy fix: every face must be physically attached to a visible neck and bare shoulder that runs off the nearest frame edge. No head may float free in the sky, and no neck may end in a cut or ragged edge. Build it as a true worm's-eye ring around a man lying on his back: the leader leans in from the LEFT edge, his neck and shoulder running out of the left border; the Young Fisherman leans over from BEYOND THE TOP EDGE, his head foreshortened and inverted (chin toward the top border, headband toward the sky's centre), with neck and shoulders running out of the top border; the wary elder leans in least from the RIGHT edge, neck and net-covered shoulder running out of the right border. Show only bare necks, shoulder tops, hair and beards, with no vests or lungis. The leader's white cotton cloth lies on his own LEFT shoulder. Because he faces down toward the viewer, it appears on the viewer's RIGHT side of his face, between him and the centre of the frame. Keep the three faces as drawn (grizzled broad-faced leader with white teeth, slim young man with thin black beard and cloth headband, gaunt elder with long grey-streaked beard), the flat rice-water-grey sky, and the single blank outlined caption box in clear sky at the lower centre.

decisions.issues: v02 is acceptable with minor flaws. (1) The speech balloon's tail is short and horizontal, and its tip meets the Fisherman's temple and hairline about a head's height above his mouth. Attribution is still clear, because he is the only speaker near it. (2) The Fisherman's white cloth drapes over his RIGHT shoulder (viewer's left) rather than the LEFT shoulder given in 2.1 and 2.4. Otherwise it is correct: Nagoji has the thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin and small gold stud; one bandaged hand is half raised to guard his face; the rope loops cross his chest; the Fisherman's rough hand pushes his hair back; the red lungi and cream vest match 2.4; the background is surf and black rock; the balloon comes before the caption in reading order. v01 is rejected: its background shows a harbour with masted boats, a fort and extra onlookers (one in a turban), which does not fit the empty beach, and Nagoji's raised hand has bare fingers where the bandage should be.

v02 is acceptable with minor flaws. (1) The balloon's tail tip touches the crown of Nagoji's hair and points toward his brow, not his mouth. Only Nagoji's face is in the panel, so attribution is still clear. (2) The pot pours from just off his lips rather than being pressed to them. (3) No rope loops are visible on his chest (only rope-burn marks). They may be hidden behind the bottom caption, which sits at armpit level. Otherwise it is correct: water runs down his clean-shaven chin and moustache, the gold stud shows, the Fisherman's forearm and cream vest edge match 2.2 and 2.4, the surf background matches 2.2, and the balloon (top) comes before the caption (bottom). v01 is rejected: it has Portuguese soldiers with morions and a fort in the background, a European-dressed man in a coat holding the pot, and the scar is shown on Nagoji's forearm too early.

v03 is v02 with only the earring edited: it now has the small flush gold stud from the sheet, where v02 has a larger hoop or crescent. A faint ghost arc of the old hoop remains under the stud. Minor flaws shared by v02 and v03: (1) Nagoji's right hand, near his chest in shadow, shows bare fingers instead of bandaged ones. (2) The wrecked ship reads weathered dark brown rather than black. (3) The sand crust near the left elbow is a textured patch, but it sits on the outer side near the elbow, so it does not read as the brand. Everything else matches the script: the view is from behind Nagoji's left shoulder; he props on his left elbow with the forearm flat and a bandaged hand; the cut rope loops lie on the sand; the Fisherman has a red lungi, cream vest and cloth on his LEFT shoulder; the Young Fisherman has an indigo lungi, blue vest and headband, and is sliding a knife into his waist-knot; the Wary Fisherman has an off-white lungi, brown vest and net; the ship's boat lies broken to the right; the high-sided ship with its carved stern castle and snapped masts sits heeled on the reef; palms and black rock are present. The one caption box is top left, clear of faces. v01 is rejected: Nagoji's left hand is unbandaged.

v01 matches the beat: a surf-line strip with foam, floating planks and a torn scrap of sail, and no human figure. It has two blank caption boxes side by side along the top, in the correct left-to-right reading order. Its look is a little more photographic than 2.4's inked painting, but it matches 2.1 to 2.3. v02 is rejected: an unpainted white band fills roughly the bottom third of the frame (beyond the two caption boxes), leaving an extra blank area and a broken composition.

Script 3.1 has two speech lines, but every candidate uses two plain rectangles with no tails, so neither balloon points to the Young Fisherman or the Fisherman. v01: set in a stone dungeon with a barred window, and the Fisherman wears a red turban. v02: a stone fort in the background; the Young Fisherman is bare-chested with no vest, his arm ends in a bandaged hand that belongs to Nagoji (anatomy error), and the forearm marks look letter-like. v03: the same grafted bandaged hand on the Young Fisherman and no vest. v04: grey sky matches page 2, but the Fisherman wears a red vest instead of cream and both lungis are plaid. v07, v08, v09: costumes are close, but the sky is sunny blue, which breaks the grey storm-spent sky of page 2 and 3.3. Their lungis are plaid (the script asks for plain dyed colours), and Nagoji's right foot has bandaged toes, which the script never calls for.
decisions.correction: Keep the v08 composition exactly: Nagoji half sitting at centre (torn ochre tunic open over rope burns, cream dhoti, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud). The Young Fisherman kneels at viewer left (thin black beard, cloth headband, faded blue sleeveless vest, indigo lungi) and turns up Nagoji's right hand, whose fingers are wrapped and heel of the palm is bare. The Fisherman kneels at viewer right (forties, short grizzled beard, bare head, cream sleeveless vest, plain white cloth over his own LEFT shoulder, madder-red lungi) and scrapes wet sand from Nagoji's inner left forearm just above the slipping wrist bandage; the mark is not readable. Fix: make the sky a flat, heavy, storm-spent grey overcast with no blue sky and no sunshine, matching the previous page. Make both lungis plain solid dyed cloth with no plaid or checks. Nagoji's feet are bare with no bandage on toes or feet. No fort or buildings. Replace the two rectangles with exactly two blank white oval speech balloons with thin black outlines along the top edge. Balloon one sits top-left above the Young Fisherman, with its tail pointing down to his mouth. Balloon two sits top-right above the Fisherman, with its tail pointing down to his mouth. Keep both balloons clear of all faces and hands.

decisions.issues: Minor: the blurred background is bright and sunny, not the overcast grey of the neighbouring panels, and the brand sits fairly close to the wrist bandage. Otherwise it is a clean, tight insert: inner LEFT forearm with the elbow crease visible, a pale puckered patch of raised ridges with no letters, numerals or cross, the Fisherman's sandy thumb at the edge, the soaked wrist bandage below, and no text areas (correct, since the panel has no lettering). v05 is also acceptable but reads more as a bumpy blob than a row of ridges. v01 is reddish with distinct vertical strokes that verge on pseudo-letters. v06 shows Nagoji's fingers unbandaged and a rash-like blob.

Script 3.3 needs one caption (no tail) and then two Wary Fisherman balloons whose tails point to his mouth. v01: sunset lighting, a crowd of extra villagers, the Wary Fisherman in a white shirt and headband, and balloon tails pointing at other men. v02: he is bare-chested with no brown vest and a short beard, he wades thigh-deep, two other fishermen intrude, and both tails point to them. v03: cream vest instead of dark brown, knee-deep, and both tails point at the cliffs, away from him. v04: closest (grey sky, wreck, dark brown vest, off-white lungi, net), but all three reserves are tailless rectangles. He also has a short beard and black hair instead of page 2's long grey-streaked beard and grey-streaked hair, and he stands knee-deep, not ankle-deep.
decisions.correction: Keep v04's staging: a lone gaunt older fisherman at the tide line, a flat grey storm sky, the wrecked high-sided black ship heeled over on the reef offshore with its mainmast snapped, black rocks and a palm-covered headland. He wears a dark brown sleeveless vest and an undyed off-white lungi, with a coiled net over one shoulder. Fix: give him the page 2 face, a long grey-streaked beard reaching his chest and long grey-streaked hair. He stands only ankle-deep, on wet sand where thin foam runs over his feet, with his head turned to glance up the coast toward the wreck and his eyes sliding back toward camera-left, uneasy. No other people in frame. Put him in the right-centre of the panel. Draw exactly three blank reserves across the top in reading order. First, a plain rectangular caption box in the top-left corner, with no tail. Second, a blank white oval speech balloon at top-centre. Third, a blank oval speech balloon at top-right. Both balloon tails point down directly to the Wary Fisherman's mouth, never toward the cliffs, the wreck or empty space. All reserves stay clear of his face and the wreck.

decisions.issues: v01: the Fisherman wears a red turban, no vest and a white dhoti, in a crowded fish-market scene with baskets and extra men; wrong setting and cast. v02: red turban and long cream shirt, and four balloons instead of three, one of them pointing to Nagoji. v03: red vest instead of cream, and two of the three tails point to Nagoji, who does not speak here. v04: the Fisherman is beardless (moustache and stubble only, so not the grizzled forties leader), and he looks at Nagoji instead of turning to the Wary Fisherman. Only one of the three balloons has a tail, and the sunny blue sky breaks page continuity.
decisions.correction: Same lonely beach as 3.1: wet sand, black rocks, surf, the wreck offshore, flat grey storm-spent overcast. No fish baskets, no crowd, no market, no beached boats, no turbans. The Fisherman is forties with a broad face, short grizzled grey beard and bare curly head. He wears a cream sleeveless vest, a plain white cloth over his own LEFT shoulder and a plain madder-red lungi. He is still crouched at Nagoji's side, but has snorted and turned his head away from Nagoji toward the Wary Fisherman, with an open-palmed haggling gesture. The Wary Fisherman stands small in the background a few paces off at the tide line (gaunt, long grey-streaked beard, dark brown vest, off-white lungi, net on shoulder). Nagoji sits beside him: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud, torn ochre tunic open over rope burns, cream dhoti. His fingers are wrapped in bandage with wrist bandages slipping, and there are no irons. Draw exactly three blank white oval speech balloons across the top edge, read left to right. Every tail points down to the Fisherman's mouth; no tail points toward Nagoji or the Wary Fisherman. All balloons stay clear of faces and hands.

decisions.issues: v01: a fort on a hill, extra villagers and a pier; the Fisherman wears a draped cloth and hair knot, not his cream vest and red lungi. v02: the 'Fisherman' has a headband and a net, blending the Young and Wary Fishermen, and one balloon tail points to Nagoji. v03: the best staging (Fisherman leaning in with his hand at his chin, Nagoji meeting his eyes). But the Fisherman wears a red vest instead of cream, and two of the three tails point at Nagoji, who does not speak. No tail marks the off-panel Wary Fisherman line. Nagoji's hands show no finger or wrist bandages, and the sky is partly sunny.
decisions.correction: Keep v03's composition and faces. The Fisherman is at left, leaning in close with one hand at his chin, doing sums (short grizzled beard, bare curly head). Nagoji is at right, meeting his eyes (thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud, torn ochre tunic open over rope burns, cream dhoti). Fix: the Fisherman wears a cream sleeveless vest, a plain white cloth over his own LEFT shoulder and a plain madder-red lungi with no plaid; no red vest. Nagoji's fingers are wrapped in soaked bandage and loose bandages slip at both wrists. Make the sky a flat grey storm-spent overcast matching the rest of the page, with the wreck in the surf behind. Draw exactly three blank white oval speech balloons, none with a tail toward Nagoji. Balloon one sits in the top-left corner with its tail running out through the left panel border, for the off-panel Wary Fisherman. Balloon two sits at top-centre, right of balloon one, with its tail pointing down-left to the Fisherman's mouth. Balloon three sits below balloon two, in the gap between the two faces above their hands, with its tail pointing left to the Fisherman's mouth. Keep all balloons clear of both faces.

decisions.issues: 4.1 has one lettering line (Nagoji), so it needs exactly one blank balloon with its tail on Nagoji's mouth. v03 and v04 have no balloon. v02 has a plain box with no tail. v05 has two balloons, with tails on the Fisherman and the Young Fisherman, and it adds bandages to the fishermen's hands. v01 is the only one with a single balloon, but it breaks the chapter's fixed fisherman looks from 2.1 and 2.4. Its Fisherman wears a red turban and a long white shirt and has no beard, only a thick moustache and a gold ear stud, so he reads as a double of Nagoji. The Young Fisherman is bare-chested with no vest, and the Wary Fisherman is in a white wrap instead of the brown vest. The tail also ends on the wreck mast, well above and to the right of Nagoji's head, not at his mouth. The rest of the page will carry the cream-vest, grizzled-beard Fisherman, so v01 would break continuity. v04 has the best staging and costumes but no balloon.
decisions.correction: Keep the v04 composition exactly: overcast wreck beach, broken high-sided ship in the surf on the left, and Nagoji up on his right elbow in the centre foreground. He has a thick curled moustache, a clean-shaven chin, a small gold ear stud, long wet curly hair, the torn soaked ochre tunic and the cream dhoti, with no irons, chain or collar. The Fisherman crouches at his left in a madder-red lungi and cream sleeveless vest, with a white cloth over his LEFT shoulder, a short grizzled beard, no turban and no ear stud. The Young Fisherman stands over them in a faded blue vest, indigo lungi and cloth headband, with a thin black beard. Add one change: turn the Wary Fisherman (gaunt, long grey-streaked beard, dark brown vest, off-white lungi, coiled net) a few paces off to the right into a back three-quarter view, walking toward the palms. Paint exactly ONE blank white speech balloon with a thin black outline, wide and short, in the open grey sky above Nagoji, between the wreck's masts and the Young Fisherman's head. Keep it clear of every face. Its tail must run straight down to end just above Nagoji's mouth. Draw no other balloons, boxes or captions, and put no letters or marks inside the balloon.

decisions.issues: 4.2 has three Fisherman lines, so it needs three blank balloons, each with a tail on the Fisherman's mouth. v03 and v04 have no balloons. v02 has three boxes with tails on three different fishermen, and the Young Fisherman's head floats cut off in the sky. v01 moves the scene to a village landing, puts the Fisherman in a turban and bare-chested, and turns the foreground listener into a man in a cream shirt with a leather strap instead of Nagoji in his ochre rags. v05 is closest: three balloons in the right order and the right costume. But its third tail ends at the Fisherman's pointing fingers, not his mouth, and that pointing hand is wrapped in a white bandage, which is wrong for the uninjured Fisherman. In v03, v04 and v05 the Fisherman stands, although he is crouched at Nagoji's side in 4.1 and 4.4.
decisions.correction: Keep the v04 look: sunny beach, black rocks, surf on the right, and the line of coconut palms running south down the coast into a pale haze and a distant headland. Nagoji's wet curly head and torn ochre tunic shoulder are seen from behind at the left edge, with his small gold ear stud. The Fisherman keeps his short grizzled beard, cream sleeveless vest, madder-red lungi and white cloth over his LEFT shoulder. Change his pose: he stays CROUCHED at Nagoji's side, as in 4.1 and 4.4, head turned to jerk his chin south down the coast. His right arm may point loosely along the shoreline at horizon height. BOTH his hands are bare, with no bandage, wrap or glove. Paint exactly THREE blank white speech balloons with thin black outlines, all above the line of his arm and clear of his face and hand. Balloon 1 is highest, in the upper left over the palms. Balloon 2 is to its right at the same height or slightly lower, in the sky right of his head. Balloon 3 sits below balloon 2 on the right, over the sky and haze. EVERY tail, including balloon 3's, runs to end at the Fisherman's mouth; none points at his hand. Put no text or marks in the balloons and add no other boxes.

decisions.issues: v03 is clean. Nagoji matches the sheet: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud, long curly hair and the torn ochre tunic, on the sunny beach. The blank caption box sits at the top with no tail. The speech balloon sits below it, with its tail on his mouth, and both are clear of his face. Minor points: he is shown sitting with his forearm on a raised knee, not propped on one elbow. His left forearm rests inner side down, so the brand is correctly out of view. His finger and wrist bandages match the page 3 script. v01 fails because it is set in a stone dungeon with a wall chain. v02 has no text areas.

4.4 needs three blank balloons: the Fisherman first, then two for Nagoji, each with a tail on the speaker's mouth. v01 is set inside a stone room with a barred window, not on the beach. v02 puts the Fisherman in different clothes under a stormy sky, and its third area is a box with no tail. v03 has no balloons. v05 has the right staging and two correct tails, but its third area (for Nagoji's 'That is enough.') is a box at the bottom with no tail. It also wraps the Fisherman's hands in bandages, gives Nagoji full mitten-like wraps, and makes his ear stud pale instead of gold. v03 and v05 both add a hilltop fort that 4.1 does not have.
decisions.correction: Keep the v05/v03 two-shot: the Fisherman crouched on the left with brows raised in surprise, in a madder-red lungi and cream sleeveless vest, a white cloth over his LEFT shoulder, and a short grizzled beard. Nagoji is on the right, still propped on one elbow on the wet sand, back straight, chin lifted, shoulders squared. He has a thick curled moustache, a clean-shaven chin, a small GOLD ear stud, long wet curly hair, the torn ochre tunic and the cream dhoti, with no irons. The overcast wreck surf and palms sit behind them, as in panel 4.1, with no hilltop fort. The Fisherman's hands are bare and unbandaged. Nagoji's bandage wraps only his fingers and wrist, with no mitten wraps. Paint exactly THREE blank white speech balloons with thin black outlines, each with a tail and none as a plain box. Balloon 1 goes top left above the Fisherman, with its tail to his mouth. Balloon 2 goes top right above Nagoji, at the same height as balloon 1 or slightly lower, with its tail to Nagoji's mouth. Balloon 3 is smaller, below balloon 2, in the sky to the right of Nagoji's head, with its own tail to Nagoji's mouth. Keep all three clear of both faces. Put nothing along the bottom edge and no text or marks inside the balloons.

decisions.issues: 4.5 needs two blank balloons, both with tails on the Fisherman's mouth. v03 has no balloons. v02 has two boxes with tails on two different men and puts the Fisherman in a red turban. v01 also gives the Fisherman a turban, a bare chest and a checked lungi, and its second tail points at the Young Fisherman. v04 moves the scene into a village lane with laterite walls. Its second tail points at the Young Fisherman, and all three fishermen have bandaged hands. In every candidate Nagoji is carried in a two-man seat carry, not with the Fisherman at his shoulders and the Young Fisherman at his legs, and the Fisherman does not grin. v03 has the best beach, wreck, crab and costumes, but it wrongly draws a ridged brand-like mark on the Young Fisherman's forearm.
decisions.correction: Keep the v03 composition: the wreck beach with the broken ship in the surf on the right, palms and huts on the far left, and a small sand crab sidling away in the left foreground. The Wary Fisherman (gaunt, long grey-streaked beard, dark brown vest, off-white lungi, coiled net) walks ahead on the right, scanning the shore. Fix the carry. Nagoji lies lengthwise between the two men. The Fisherman (madder-red lungi, cream sleeveless vest, white cloth over his LEFT shoulder, short grizzled beard) is at his head, holding him under the shoulders and grinning broadly, white teeth showing. The Young Fisherman (faded blue vest, indigo lungi, cloth headband, thin black beard) is at his feet, holding his legs behind the knees. Nagoji keeps a thick curled moustache, a clean-shaven chin, a small gold ear stud, the torn ochre tunic and the cream dhoti, with bandaged fingers and no irons, chain or collar. No fisherman has a bandage or wrap on his hands. No scar or brand mark appears on anyone except Nagoji's own inner left forearm. Paint exactly TWO blank white speech balloons with thin black outlines in the sky above the group, clear of every face. Balloon 1 is higher and to the left, and balloon 2 is to its right at the same height or lower. BOTH tails end at the Fisherman's grinning mouth. Draw no boxes, captions or text.

decisions.issues: Minor only. The Wary Fisherman leads but also has one hand under Nagoji's foot. The wreck is a little larger than 'small and far off'. Nagoji's chin shows a faint shadow, within the bible's 'light stubble at most'. The bottom-right caption box hides the Wary Fisherman's right hand and the lower part of his net, but no face or key action. Otherwise correct: high angle from the palms back to the sea, Fisherman (red lungi) at the shoulders, Young Fisherman (indigo lungi, headband) at the legs, Nagoji head back with eyes open toward the fronds, thick curled moustache, clean chin, small gold ear ornament. No irons. The ship's boat lies untouched on the sand and the wreck on the reef has nobody on it. Two blank caption boxes, top-left then bottom-right. v05 is the same staging with thinner caption boxes and a slightly more dangling ear drop. v01 is rejected: wrong carrier assignment, the Wary Fisherman carrying instead of leading, and a mark on the shin. v02 to v04 are weaker: eyes closed or half-closed, and v03 is a drop earring.

The girl's line is speech, but v02, v03 and v04 each paint only a tail-less rectangle with no tail to the girl. In v02 and v03 Nagoji hangs upright with his arms over their shoulders and his feet dangling, which breaks the horizontal carry set up in 5.1 and 5.3. v03 and v04 dress the small girl and her companion in fitted short-sleeved stitched blouses, which is anachronistic for a 1738 Kerala village child. v01 shows Nagoji walking upright with bound wrists instead of being carried. v04 is otherwise the best base: horizontal carry, laterite and thatch houses, wet paddy, covered village women with brass pots, girl whispering behind her hand in the left foreground.
decisions.correction: Keep the v04 composition exactly: the village path between wet paddy, red laterite and mud houses with palm-thatch roofs, and village women in plain mundu with the upper cloth over both shoulders holding water pots. Keep Nagoji carried horizontally in the middle distance, the Fisherman (red lungi, off-white shoulder cloth) at his shoulders and the Young Fisherman (indigo lungi, headband) under his knees. Keep the small girl whispering behind her cupped hand to the child beside her in the left foreground, her eyes on Nagoji. Remove the large tail-less rectangle at top-left. In its place paint ONE small blank white speech balloon with a solid black outline in the open upper-left area above the two children, clear of every face. Give it a clear pointed tail that runs down to the girl's cupped hand at her mouth, so it is unmistakably her line. Dress the girl as a small child of about six: a loose undyed cotton top and a plain red-brown ankle skirt, no fitted or short-sleeved stitched blouse, matching the small girl in the doorway in panel 5.3. Give her companion a plain cloth or bare shoulders, no stitched blouse. Nagoji keeps a clean-shaven chin, the thick curled moustache, a small gold ear stud and wrapped hands, with no irons, chains or rope at his wrists. No text or letters anywhere in the art.

decisions.issues: Minor only in v04. Both balloon tails end at the Young Fisherman's hair and forehead rather than right at his mouth, but both clearly aim at him, not at Nagoji. Nagoji's wrapped hand on the Fisherman's shoulder reads slightly glove-like. The Young Fisherman's headband is grey-mauve rather than the off-white of 5.1. Otherwise correct: inland laterite village, the Young Fisherman at the legs turning sharply toward a small girl shrinking back in a doorway, the Fisherman at the shoulders at the far end, Nagoji with a clean chin, thick curled moustache and small gold stud, no irons, two balloons read left to right. No backup: v02 and v03 draw the girl as an adolescent in a sari with a fitted short-sleeved blouse, not a small girl, and v02's bare-fingered hand drifts from the wrapped hands. v01 is on the beach with a grown woman in place of the girl.

No candidate shows the panel's key beat: the brand on Nagoji's inner LEFT forearm turned to camera, with the Woman's gaze fixed on it. In v04 to v07 Nagoji's near arm is his right, and the forearm is bandaged or covered. In every candidate both lines belong to the Woman, but the first (left) balloon or box has no tail. v01 also points its first tail at the Fisherman. v04 to v07 paint a glass-chimney lantern inside the doorway, which is barred in Kerala settings. The Fisherman is carrying and glaring, not beside her mid-gesture and talking. The Woman frowns (v05 to v07, also reaching out a hand) instead of wiping her hands with a faint betel-stained half-smile. v01 and v03 show Nagoji standing, not held between the carriers. v05 to v07 work for the horizontal carry, the laterite house doorway and the Woman's look (grey-streaked hair, undyed cotton over both shoulders, no blouse, no gold).
decisions.correction: Keep the v06/v07 setting and cast: the low laterite and thatch house doorway at the village edge, Nagoji carried horizontally between the Fisherman (red lungi, off-white shoulder cloth) at his shoulders and the Young Fisherman (indigo lungi, headband) under his knees, and the Woman in the doorway: heavy-set, in her fifties, grey-streaked hair in a loose low knot, coarse undyed cotton worn sari-fashion over both shoulders, no blouse, no gold. Change these: (1) Nagoji's LEFT arm lies across his body toward the camera with the inner forearm facing the viewer. A hand's width above the bandaged wrist it shows the brand clearly: a pale, puckered patch of raised ridges like old burned letters blurred past reading, with no legible letters, no numerals and no cross. The torn ochre tunic hangs open over raw red rope burns across his chest. (2) The Fisherman stands beside the Woman, holding Nagoji's shoulders with one arm while his free hand gestures toward her, mouth open mid-speech. (3) The Woman steps out of the doorway wiping both hands on the end of her cloth, eyes cast down on the brand, lips betel-stained, with a faint half-smile at one corner of her mouth, not a frown. She is not reaching out. (4) The doorway interior is plain dark shadow: no lantern, no glass, and no lamp with a glass chimney. (5) Paint two blank white speech balloons with black outlines, both the Woman's: the first upper-center above the Young Fisherman's head, the second upper-right above the Woman. Each has its own clear pointed tail running down to the Woman's mouth. Both stay clear of every face and of the brand. Nagoji keeps a clean-shaven chin, the thick curled moustache and a small gold ear stud, with no irons or chains. No text or letters anywhere in the art.

decisions.issues: v02, v03 and v04 paint two tail-less rectangles. The second box, Nagoji's line 'Asked questions.', sits top-right over the Woman, so it reads as her speech. v01's second tail points at the Woman instead of Nagoji, and v01 puts the Woman in a fitted blouse. v02 leaves the Woman's right shoulder bare. In all of them the brand on the inner left forearm is at most a faint crackle and does not read. v04 is otherwise the best base: rope burns on the chest, the salt-stiff tunic set aside on the mat, the Woman in undyed cotton over both shoulders with a grey low knot and her mouth pulled tight, the hand hidden in the wet cloth over a clay basin, the Fisherman squatting in red lungi at the mat's edge, smoke rising to the thatch, and Nagoji with a clean chin, moustache and gold stud.
decisions.correction: Keep the v04 composition, cast and costumes exactly: Nagoji half-reclining on the woven mat in the cream dhoti with red rope burns across his bare chest, the ochre tunic in a pile beside him, the Fisherman (red lungi, off-white shoulder cloth) squatting at the mat's left edge, and the Woman at right with undyed cotton covering both shoulders, no blouse, a grey-streaked low knot and her mouth pulled tight. She washes his extended left arm over a clay basin, his fingers hidden inside her wet cloth. Keep smoke rising from a small hearth to a hole in the thatch, with the interior kept dim and cool. Change these: (1) Turn his left forearm so its inner side faces up toward the camera. A hand's width above the wrist, just above her cloth, show the brand clearly: a pale, puckered patch of raised ridges like old burned letters blurred past reading, with no legible letters, no numerals and no cross. (2) Replace the two tail-less rectangles with two blank white speech balloons with black outlines. The first goes at top-left above the Fisherman, with a clear pointed tail down to the Fisherman's mouth. The second goes at top-center above Nagoji's head and left of the Woman, with a clear pointed tail down to Nagoji's mouth. Leave the top-right area over the Woman free of balloons. Keep both balloons clear of all faces. Nagoji keeps a clean-shaven chin, the thick curled moustache and a small gold ear stud, with no irons or chains. No text or letters anywhere in the art.

decisions.issues: No candidate is acceptable. Both lines in 6.1 belong to the Fisherman, so both balloon tails must point to him. v04 is the closest: dim thatched interior, the Woman (grey-streaked knot, undyed cotton, no blouse) wringing the cloth into the basin, the Fisherman (red lungi, cream vest, white cloth on his left shoulder) gesturing, and Nagoji on the mat with the correct face, ear stud and clean chin. But its first (left) balloon tail points at the Woman's head, so her name would sit on the Fisherman's line. Nagoji's fingers are also shown fairly plainly. v01 and v02 open onto the beach, sea, boats and sky. That breaks the dim inland interior of 5.5. Both also add extra men, including the gaunt, grey-bearded Wary Fisherman the script says is not in the house, and in both the first balloon tail points at the Woman. The Woman in v02 also wears a gold earring (script: no gold).
decisions.correction: Keep the v04 composition exactly: the dim interior of the same mud-and-laterite, palm-thatched house as 5.5, with hearth glow, the Woman at left wringing the cloth hard into the basin with her mouth open mid-scold, the Fisherman seated centre-right (short grizzled beard, faded madder-red lungi, cream sleeveless vest, white cotton cloth on his LEFT shoulder) relaying her words with one open hand and a half smile, and Nagoji reclining on the woven mat in the right foreground. Fix the balloons: both lines are the FISHERMAN's, so draw two blank speech balloons in the upper part of the frame, the first higher and further left and the second to its right, both clear of every face, and point BOTH tails clearly at the Fisherman's mouth. No tail points toward the Woman or Nagoji. The room is fully enclosed, with no open wall, beach, sea, boats or sky. Only these three people are present: no old gaunt grey-bearded man and no other fishermen. The Woman wears no gold. Nagoji's hands rest with the fingers curled into shadow or wrapped in loose slipping linen, so his fingers are not shown clearly.

decisions.issues: No candidate is acceptable. v01 gets the boy right (hand on the frame, panting, grey daylight) and has a correct balloon (tail to the boy's mouth) and a bottom caption. But it adds a third man at right: gaunt, with a long grey beard. That is the Wary Fisherman, whom the page introduction says is not in the house. The Fisherman and Young Fisherman both stare at the boy instead of exchanging a look with each other. The doorway also shows the beach, surf and moored ships, which does not fit the inland village among the paddy (5.2). v04 is set outdoors in bright sun with blue sky and paddy, not grey daylight inside a room. Its 'Fisherman' wears a cream dhoti and a wrist bandage, with no red lungi and no shoulder cloth. Its Young Fisherman has no indigo lungi or blue vest. And the two men do not exchange a look.
decisions.correction: Set the panel inside the same dim mud-and-laterite, palm-thatched house as 5.5 and 6.1: hearth glow, packed and swept earth floor, woven mats, baskets and clay pots. At frame left, a barefoot village boy in a plain cloth stands in the doorway, panting, one hand gripping the door frame, backlit by flat grey overcast daylight. Through the doorway show only coconut palms and wet paddy: no sea, no beach, no ships. Inside there are only two men, seated apart across the room: the Fisherman (forties, stocky, short grizzled beard, faded madder-red lungi, cream sleeveless vest, white cotton cloth on his LEFT shoulder) and the Young Fisherman (twenties, slim, thin black beard, cloth headband, indigo lungi, faded blue vest). They have turned to look at EACH OTHER across the room, a quick knowing glance, not at the boy. No third man, no old grey-bearded man, and Nagoji not in frame. Keep v01's reserves: one blank speech balloon at upper left-centre with its tail pointing to the boy's open mouth, and one blank rectangular caption box (no tail) along the bottom right, clear of all faces.

decisions.issues: No candidate is acceptable. Both have the Fisherman's first speech balloon with its tail pointing down at Nagoji's head, but both balloons in 6.3 are the Fisherman's. In both, the right side of the room opens onto the sea, a fort on a headland and beached boats. That does not match the dim inland village interior of 5.5 and 6.1. v01 also puts the Wary Fisherman (old, gaunt, long grey beard) and the Young Fisherman in the background, though the script has only the two principals in this beat. v01 also shows the brand on the outer forearm as letter-like marks that read as pseudo-text. v03 otherwise works well: the Fisherman in red lungi crouches and uses his right hand to adjust the white cloth on his own left shoulder, and Nagoji (correct face, ear stud, clean chin, bandaged wrists) looks up at him.
decisions.correction: Keep v03's figures and staging exactly: Nagoji half-reclined on the woven mat at left, bandaged wrists, looking up at the Fisherman, and the Fisherman crouched at right (short grizzled beard, red lungi, white cloth) adjusting that cloth on his own LEFT shoulder with his right hand, voice low, plus the small open-wick clay lamp at left and the wide blank caption box along the bottom. Fix two things. (1) Both speech balloons are the FISHERMAN's. Place both in the upper centre-right, above and near the Fisherman, the first further left or higher than the second, with BOTH tails pointing clearly to the Fisherman's mouth and none toward Nagoji. Keep them clear of both faces. (2) Close the room. Replace the open right side (sea, fort, headland, boats, sky) with the enclosed interior of the same dim mud-and-red-laterite, palm-thatched house as 5.5 and 6.1: earth walls, shelves of clay pots, warm hearth glow. No window or opening onto the sea. No other people in frame. Nagoji's left forearm is turned down or covered, with no marks or letters visible on his skin.

decisions.issues: No candidate is acceptable. v01 shows the Wary Fisherman (gaunt, long grey beard), who is not in the house on this page. Nagoji's forearm brand is painted as legible block letters (reads like 'IHB'). The script wants only a broad shadow on the floor, but v01 puts a full figure in the doorway in a dark coat and boots with a sword, which reads as a European soldier rather than the kapitan. The doorway also opens onto a palm beach and sea. v03 has the right dim thatched room and Nagoji with eyes closed in hearth light. But the Fisherman there wears cream cloth instead of the red lungi. The Young Fisherman wears a sleeved cream shirt and cream lungi instead of indigo lungi and blue vest. Neither turns toward the door or straightens, there is no shadow across the floor, and the background is not out of focus.
decisions.correction: Full-width tier set inside the same dim mud-and-laterite, palm-thatched house as 5.5 and 6.1. Foreground: Nagoji (thick curled moustache, CLEAN-SHAVEN chin, small gold ear stud, long loose curly hair, bare-chested with rope burns, cream dhoti) half-reclined on the woven mat, eyes CLOSED, face lit warm and gold by the hearth. His left forearm is turned down or wrapped, with no brand, marks, letters or symbols visible on his skin. Behind him, in soft out-of-focus depth, show ONLY two men: the Fisherman (short grizzled beard, red lungi, cream vest, white cloth on his LEFT shoulder) and the Young Fisherman (thin black beard, cloth headband, indigo lungi, faded blue vest). Both are turning their heads toward the doorway at frame right and straightening up from a crouch. No third man and no old grey-bearded man. The doorway shows only flat grey daylight and a hint of palms, with no sea or beach. NO figure is visible in the doorway: only the broad, squat shadow of a stocky man stretches in across the swept earth floor toward the mat. Two blank rectangular caption boxes, top-left and top-right, no tails, clear of Nagoji's face.

decisions.issues: No candidate is acceptable. v01 is closest. The kapitan is right: white turban, short grey-flecked beard, scar from his left ear to his jaw on the camera side, pale vest over white mundu, no coat. The fishermen are correctly dressed, and the three caption boxes are placed in the right order. But Nagoji lies with his head at frame left, facing right, with his RIGHT ear toward camera, so the branded arm stretched across the foreground is his RIGHT forearm. The bible and script put the brand on the LEFT. The hand is also shown bare, whole and healthy, palm up. That contradicts the rule that his ruined fingers are never shown directly and the bandages of the neighbouring panels. The kapitan reads taller than both fishermen, not shorter and broader with the Young Fisherman half a head taller just behind him. A looped rope hangs from an iron ring on the post at right, which reads as noose-like. v02 has the same right-arm brand and bare hand. Its kapitan is seated rather than stepping in. Its 'Fisherman' has a long grey beard, a brown vest and an off-white lungi, so he reads as the Wary Fisherman, who is absent from this page. v05 puts the kapitan small in a sunny doorway, with the fishermen holding Nagoji upright. There is no low camera from the mat and no face-to-face weighing.
decisions.correction: Keep v01's room, warm hearth light, low camera from beside the mat, the kapitan's look (white turban, short grey-flecked beard, scar from his LEFT ear to the corner of his jaw on the side facing camera, pale buttoned vest over a white mundu, striped shoulder cloth, no coat), the two fishermen's costumes and the three blank caption boxes (top-left, top-right, bottom-right). Fix Nagoji's orientation so the brand is on his LEFT arm. Nagoji is in the lower-left foreground, propped on his right elbow on the mat, with his chest turned toward camera in three-quarter front view and his head turned up toward the kapitan, eyes open, looking straight at him. His LEFT arm (the one on the frame-right side of his body) lies stretched along the mat toward the kapitan, inner forearm up, showing the brand as a pale puckered patch of raised ridges with no letter shapes. The fingers of that hand are curled closed and half in shadow, or wrapped in a loose slipping linen bandage, never shown whole and open. The kapitan stands a pace inside the room at centre-right, facing frame-left and looking down so his LEFT cheek and scar face camera. He must read SHORTER but broader than the fishermen: the Young Fisherman (headband, indigo lungi, blue vest) stands directly behind him and is clearly half a head taller, drawing back respectfully beside the Fisherman (red lungi, cream vest, white cloth on his left shoulder). Grey daylight from the doorway only rims the kapitan's shoulders. Remove the rope and iron ring from the post: no hanging or looped rope anywhere; put shelves of clay pots there instead.
